item: the columnar job runs the nineteen DuckDB-gated test files that no job had run
summary: Q's ratchet (#1644) measured 19 test files gated on duckdb that skip in every blocking job because only the columnar job installs [columnar] and its first pytest step named 12 files. The step now names all 19, appended after the existing list, and the 19 KNOWN_UNCOVERED lines are deleted in the same change (the ratchet fails for a line left behind and for a gated file no job names; the two playwright lines stay, a Chromium download no job installs). Measured on the fresh main tip with a scratch install: 230 passed on duckdb 1.5.6 (63 s) and 229 passed, 1 skipped on duckdb 2.0.0 (42 s; the skip is the documented join-plan test that DuckDB 2.0.0 cannot tell apart), against 0 of them run in CI before. Stated limits: a duckdb-gated file added later still needs its own entry (the ratchet fails for it); the columnar job gains these 19 files' run time (42 to 63 s in this container); the runner's own figure is not measured here.
